## Importing the Sara_dataset.xls into R {transition="slide"}

\

```{r}
#| echo: FALSE

rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

dataset <- read_excel("Sara_dataset.xls")
```

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1,2|4"}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)     

dataset <- read_excel("Sara_dataset.xls")
```

\

First lets load the needed packages.^[package `readxl` is loaded separately because it's not part of the core tidyverse.]

\

Then lets import the Sara_dataset into R using the `read_excel()` function.

# Analysing the variables {transition=“zoom”}



## Math pre-test

::: {style="font-size: .6em;"}
Self reported fear of mathematics and performance in the mathematics pre-test are negatively correlated\
(**$r =$ `r round(cor(dataset$phobia, dataset$mathquiz, use = "complete.obs"), 2)`**)^[*Pearson's* $r$, calculated with $\frac{s_{xy}}{s_{x}s_{y}}$]
:::

```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
dataset |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = phobia,
      y = mathquiz
    )
  ) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", col = "red", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "n = 100",
    x = "Self-reported fear of mathematics (0-10)",
    y = "Matemathics pre-test score (0-50)",
    caption = "n = 100"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 15)
  )
```



## Stat pre-test

::: {style="font-size: .6em;"}
Self reported fear of mathematics and performance in the statistics pre-test are negatively correlated\
(**$r =$ `r round(cor(dataset$phobia, dataset$statquiz, use = "complete.obs"), 2)`**)^[*Pearson's* $r$, calculated with $\frac{s_{xy}}{s_{x}s_{y}}$]
:::

```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
dataset |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = phobia,
      y = statquiz
    )
  ) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", col = "red", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "n = 100",
    x = "Self-reported fear of mathematics (0-10)",
    y = "Statistics pre-test score (0-50)",
    caption = "n = 100"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 15)
  )
```



## Summarizing the results

::::::: columns
::: {.column width="70%"}
**Variable**\
Self-reported fear of mathematics (0–10 scale)\
Score on a [mathematics pre-test]{style="color: blue;"} (0-50 scale)\
Score on a [statistics pre-test]{style="color: red;"} (0-10 scale)\
:::

::: {.column width="10%"}
$\bar{x}$^[sample mean, calculated with $\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i}{n}$]\
`r round(mean(dataset$phobia), 2)`\
`r round(sd(dataset$mathquiz, na.rm = TRUE), 2)`\
`r round(sd(dataset$statquiz, na.rm = TRUE), 2)`\
:::

::: {.column width="10%"}
$s$^[sample standard deviation, calculated with $\sqrt{s^{2}}$]\
`r round(sd(dataset$phobia), 2)`\
`r round(sd(dataset$mathquiz), 2)`\
`r round(sd(dataset$statquiz), 2)`
:::

::: {.column width="10%"}
$r$^[correlation with self-reported fear of mathematics, calculated using *Pearson's* $r$ ($\frac{s_{xy}}{s_{x}s_{y}}$)]\
1\
`r round(cor(dataset$phobia, dataset$mathquiz, use = "complete.obs"), 2)`\
`r round(cor(dataset$phobia, dataset$statquiz, use = "complete.obs"), 2)`
